data.long_meaning: Chaitra is the name of the lunar month in which the Hindu festival of Holi is celebrated. The prefix 'kaa' in Chaitrikaa denotes the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. This name is believed to bring abundance and prosperity. The name Chaitrikaa carries the meaning “Goddess of wealth and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chaitrikaa usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Holi is a celebration of the victory of good over evil, symbolized by the burning of bonfires and the smearing of colored powders on each other. Chaitrikaa is a name that embodies the playful, joyous, and carefree spirit of this festival.

It is believed that this name invokes the blessings of both Chaitra, the god of the month of the same name, and Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
